name: SWPanel Migrator
author: SWPanel

sections.description:
SWPanel Migrator is a tool to export your WordPress site to SWPanel using your migration token. It handles WordPress installation, database migration and file transfer automatically.

Features

  • Database Export: Creates a complete SQL dump of your WordPress database
  • File Transfer: Securely transfers all WordPress files, plugins, and themes
  • SQL Execution: Automatically executes the database dump on the destination server
  • Destination Updates: Updates the destination site configuration and URLs
  • Secure Migration: Uses tokens, secret and encryption for secure data transfer
  • Progress Tracking: Monitor migration progress with real-time status updates

External services

SWPanel Migrator is a connector plugin that helps migrate a WordPress site to a specific SWPanel service, identified by a unique token and key.

The plugin sends site files, a database dump, and basic site metadata to the external service only when the user explicitly starts the migration process. No automatic background transfers are performed.

The plugin may send the following information to the SWPanel service during migration:

  • Site files (themes, plugins, uploads, and other content required for the site)
  • A full database dump
  • Site title
  • Site description
  • Site language
  • Database table prefix
  • Absolute path to the WordPress installation
  • Site domain

This information is required to accurately transfer and recreate the site on the destination.

By using the SWPanel Migrator plugin, you agree to the SWPanel privacy policy and terms of service:

This service is provided by “SWPanel”:

  • Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy

External assets

This plugin loads Font Awesome and FusionCharts scripts and styles from “SWPanel” external servers to provide the plugin’s user interface and charts. These files are only used for styling and visual elements inside the plugin. No personal or sensitive user data is sent.

Including these assets externally allows us to reduce the plugin size and avoid increasing the download size.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/swpanel-migrator directory, or install via the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Enter your SWPanel migration token and secret to start the migration.
sections.faq:
Can I use this plugin on any WordPress site?

Yes, as long as you have access to the site files and database.

What happens if migration fails?

The plugin will report an error. You can retry the migration using the plugin interface.
